items: Changing a rung template `EncWarlock0{2–7}TemplateFire` also needs that rung's boss template `EncWarlock0NTemplateBossFire` (7 · 14 · 21 · 30 · 40 · 50, on *Warlock Bosses*), which uses it as its template but not for `Stats`.

Changing `EncWarlock00Template` 044CCC (the shared base of every rung template, which uses it without `Stats`) also needs `WIChangeLocation04Student` 06F214 (1, left out as not an enemy on the *Warlocks* group page): same pattern.

Records filed elsewhere that do carry `Stats` from a Fire rung template, so they move with it: `CWSiegeImperialWizard` 04622A (from `EncWarlock02TemplateFire`, level 6, on Factions → *Common Legion*) and CC `ccBGSSSE067_MythicDawnJanus` 0B8A14:ccbgssse067-daedinv.esm (from `EncWarlock01TemplateFire`, a corpse, on Daedra → *Mythic Dawn (CC)*).
The Fire rungs are also drawn through `LCharWarlockElemental`: the records that keep their own level beside its wrapper are on *Elemental Mages*.
Every other record here (the rung leaves, the Conjurer leaf 06D262 and every Fire wrapper) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list.
